newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Sept 5.

text.p: These are significant stories in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Ivorian cabinet gives green light for signature of contract with oil consortium formed by Shell International and United Meridian Corp for deep sea oil exploration in Ivory Coast's C105 offshore bloc.
- Ivory Coast government approves establishment of polytechnic, says communique after cabinet meeting.
- Government bans use of asbestos for buildings in Ivory Coast LA VOIE
- Price of petrol could rise following fluctuation on international markets, writes columnist Kesy Jacob.
- Diarrhoea epidemic reported in northern district around Man;
1,000 cases recorded monthly, according to region's chief medical officer.
